fields.Name: Sales: Deal Involvement by Rep (Attribution-Weighted)
fields.UserQuestion: Who contributed to which deals, and how much credit does each rep carry?
fields.Description: ATTRIBUTION BASIS: WEIGHTED BY AttributionPct. Credit is split across every active team member, so an SE who supported nine deals is visible at all — which the owner-filtered report cannot show by design. THIS DOES NOT SUM TO THE COMPANY'S BOOKINGS and is not meant to: nothing constrains a deal's attribution percentages to total 100. Use "Sales: Bookings by Owner" for any number that has to reconcile. ADDITIVITY: only WeightedWonAmount and UnstatedAttributionCount total correctly across rows. WonAmountOfDealsTouched is the whole deal repeated on every member row — on the seeded won deal it reads 27,480 three times, so summing it gives 82,440 for a deal worth 27,480. DealsInvolvedIn and AvgAttributionPct are likewise not additive.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: DealTeamMember, deliberately WITHOUT an IsOwnerRole filter — its absence is the definition of this report. WeightedWonAmount is Amount * AttributionPct / 100; both are stored values, so this splits a figure rather than pricing anything. A NULL AttributionPct counts as ZERO credit, not full: inventing 100 for an unassigned share would manufacture the overcount this query exists to expose. UnstatedAttributionCount surfaces those rows. Date dimension: ActualCloseDate.
